'''The Corner Shop''' was a grocery store in a [[Unidentified city (Cad Bane)|bustling city]] on [[Duro]] during [[Cad Bane]]'s childhood. The name of the business appeared on an [[Aurebesh]] sign on the building's facade, along with the words "[[Foodstuff|snacks]]" and "drink." An advertisement for [[Cafe 94]] also appeared on the building. The store was filled with [[fruit]], candy, and other goods, but also served as a front for a secret [[casino]] in the back room.

==History==
Between [[62 BBY]] and [[33 BBY]]<ref name="The Good Life Date">{{TalesDate|U4}}</ref>, the storefront exterior was viewed by the two [[Duros]] [[Niro]] and [[Cad Bane|Colby]], looking for food, before they got scared off by the [[Aqualish]] [[Unidentified Aqualish shopkeeper|shopkeeper]]. The two went around the corner into the nearby alleyway, and shared a fruit. They were told to scram by a Duro [[Unidentified kingpin|kingpin]] who had opened the door to the alley in order to throw out a [[Unidentified Rodian casino customer|Rodian customer]].<ref name="The Good Life" />

The two Duro boys later returned, with a [[Currency|coin]] they had been given from the [[bounty hunter]] [[Lazlo]]. As the boys browsed the goods, they noticed the same kingpin welcome a [[Human]] customer into the back, before they noticed the [[Crunchies]] the store had for sale. The boys poured a giant bowl for themselves before they attempted to check out. The Aqualish shopkeeper questioned where they had received the money, and accused the Duro boys of stealing. The shopkeeper inspected the coin, before he checked the Duro boys' groceries out, and they left with their Crunchies.<ref name="The Good Life" />

Lazlo and the Duro boys watched from across the street the next day, and Lazlo revealed that he did not like the owner of the shop as the underground [[Casino]] the owner ran messed with Lazlo's business. Lazlo offered to pay the Duro boys five coins, before Colby negotiated for ten coins, which Lazlo agreed to.

The kingpin welcomed back the human customer, who had returned to the casino, and wished him better luck this time as he entered. The kingpin then heard noises coming from the alleyway, which were the result of Colby and Niro. When he went out to tell them off, he say the Duro boys laugh, and he whistled for his security [[Droid]]s to escort the boys out. However at that moment, [[Cad Bane's gang|Lazlo's gang]] had snuck in the front, and raided the store and casino. Lazlo, his gang, and Colby ran away, when the kingpin called out for Lazlo to stop, so Lazlo shot him with his [[blaster]], killing him. However Niro was caught by the local [[Law enforcement agency|police]] [[Unidentified police force|force]].<ref name="The Good Life" />

Years later, Colby, now going by "Cad", returns to the planet [[Duro]] to investigate the death of Lazlo along with [[Arin]], and as he passes by the shop, he peers inside. While looking inside, Niro walks up, expecting to find Cad at the store. The two reunite, and Niro notes how he has changed and how Arin called his old friend Cad. Niro tells Cad that as the Police [[Deputy]], he wants to make sure Cad avoids making things messy, and reveals that the [[Unidentified marshal|marshal]] killed Lazlo. Cad and Arin then leave per the suggestion of Niro.<ref name="A Good Turn">{{TOTU|A Good Turn}}</ref>

Years later, after his meeting with [[Tay Grutty]], Niro stops as he walks past the corner shop, now covered in graffiti. He notices two small Duros children run past, before he sees a ship pass abovehead.<ref name="One Good Deed">{{TOTU|One Good Deed}}</ref>
